messages:
jon: FYI — SSO Corp wants to run a 90d POC on Dedicated. They asked for 50% off list for 3 reserved seats + 2k embed units. Need deal desk routing and exact CPQ field names to capture: POC, one-off commit, no auto-renew. @dealdesk @emily @sachin

dealbot: New quote Q-5643 created by jon. Link: https://redwood.internal/quote/Q-5643

emily: @jon is this Hosted or Dedicated? Approval path differs.

jon: Dedicated. They'll do a one-off $30k commit for the 90d evaluation and won't auto-renew.

sachin: For Dedicated POCs we typically set these fields in CPQ: Commit_Level__c = OneOff, POC_Discount__c = 50, Approval_Tier__c = Tier2, AutoRenew__c = false. Add Special_Term__c = "90d evaluation - no production SLA" and attach signed SOW.

emily: Tier2 requires dealdesk approval + sales-ops signoff. If customer requests on-prem networking or VPN, loop in eng-security. Otherwise product-ops OK.

jon: What's the SLA for Tier2? Customer wants to start next Monday.

dealdesk: @jon we'll triage once the CPQ fields + attachments are present. Standard turnaround for Tier2 is 48h (business days). If you need <48h, add Expedite__c = true and an escalation note; escalate to @sarah if we need to waive standard reviews.

jon: OK adding checklist to quote now.

jon: ```
Commit_Level__c: OneOff
POC_Discount__c: 50
Approval_Tier__c: Tier2
AutoRenew__c: false
Special_Term__c: "90d evaluation - no production SLA"
NetCommitAmount__c: 30000
Attachments: SOW.pdf, POC-plan.md
```

emily: Looks right. @sachin can you confirm there are no additional infra credit lines we should add for billing?

sachin: Confirmed — Dedicated POC costs are covered by the $30k commit, so no separate infra-credit SKUs required. Add quote comment: "no additional infra credits" for billing clarity.

jon: If dealdesk approves, can we fast-track signature? I can get legal-approved SOW today.

dealdesk: If SOW attached + CPQ fields filled, approval fits SLA. Use Expedite__c = true if customer needs <48h and add the reason in the quote notes. We'll notify here when we start review.

jon: Will attach SOW and POC acceptance criteria by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:

emily: Ping this thread when the quote goes into review so we can monitor SLA and escalate if needed.

jon: will update by EOD, thanks everyone.
